dedupe_keys.name: epa greenhouse gas reporting program ghgrp data and flight

description: The Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program requires large greenhouse gas emission sources, suppliers of fossil fuels and industrial gases, and carbon dioxide injection sites in the United States to report greenhouse gas data every year; about 8,000 facilities report, and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency publishes the data each October. The Facility Level Information on GreenHouse gases Tool (FLIGHT) filters emissions by facility, industry, location or gas in maps, charts and tables. Data sets include multi-year and yearly summary spreadsheets with emissions by gas and process (2023 data summary), reported parent companies with ownership shares, unit- and fuel-level emissions for pulp and paper, electricity generation and stationary combustion, a power plant crosswalk to EIA and other EPA identifiers, and fluorinated gas production data. Downloads are free, and as U.S. Government works the data are in the public domain. Caveats: only large sources above reporting thresholds report, and the latest summary year lags the reporting year. For simulation it gives facility-level emissions, process types and ownership of U.S. industrial plants for exposure, decarbonisation and interdependency analyses. Related catalogue records include the Toxics Release Inventory, the EPA Facility Registry Service and Climate TRACE.
